deltas.description: Qwen3.5 reference vision path explicitly removes Qwen3-VL DeepStack helper structures and returns separate pre-merger and merged outputs. This changes the feature-access frontier for Frank MVC.
deltas.effect: Adds projected-vs-premerger feature stratum as a controlled variable.

deltas.description: llama.cpp mtmd helper accepts already-calculated media embeddings for decode; same-cycle one-encode MVC->semantic escalation no longer requires assuming a private decoder hook.
deltas.effect: Promotes zero-reencode path from conceptual feasibility to P0 executable target test.

deltas.description: MobileCLIP2-S0 is a concrete very-small independent image encoder; DINOv3-S/16 offers frozen dense patch features. Separate-encoder counterhypothesis is therefore non-strawman and must be measured.
Introduced L0/L1/L2/L3 visual-state lifetime split and exact identity binding between persistent semantic state and optional runtime cache.
deltas.effect: Creates stale-state/restart/resource falsifiers and avoids raw embedding persistence as default semantic state.

deltas.description: Defined feature-ladder, zero-reencode, cache-lifetime, hybrid-restart and transform-invariance tests with matched baselines and failure criteria.
deltas.effect: Converts unresolved architecture preference into executable decision gates.

explicit_non_progress: Qwen3.5-4B being natively multimodal was already present in QNDRF-1 and is not counted as new.
mtmd_get_output_embd existence was already present in QNDRF-1 and is not counted as new.
Generic CLIP/DINO comparison was already present; only concrete refreshed counterbaseline selection and revised feature-level matrix are counted.
